responsibility: Implements the singleton wrapper that exposes a completed Resolver2_0 NameResolutionContext as read-only state to later compiler phases. This file initializes the one global ImmutableNameResolutionContext instance from a mutable resolver context, provides access to that singleton, and returns the underlying const NameResolutionContext for consumers such as post-resolution semantic analysis that must inspect bindings without mutating resolver state.
same_name_distinction: Provides the singleton instance mechanics for the immutable resolver view, including init/get and returning the wrapped const NameResolutionContext; the paired header only exposes that immutable façade’s interface.
